_provenance: Raised by engine/watch.py on 2026-08-16: four outlets carried a $2 trillion valuation against a stored $965B. Checked against PitchBook profile 466959-97 (retrieved 2026-08-16). Last Known Valuation is unchanged at $965B, dated 2026-05-28, so the $2T is not a transaction. What the check turned up instead is larger than the figure that triggered it: Anthropic has been in IPO registration since 2026-06-01, with an expected October 2026 listing. The desk had no IPO status on file.

status.value: In IPO registration. Confidentially filed 2026-06-01; expected listing October 2026
status.source: PitchBook profile 466959-97, Ownership Status and deal 325962-01T (IPO, Announced/In Progress)
status.note: A confidential filing is not public, so the S-1 itself cannot be read yet. When it becomes public it will be the first audited look at these numbers and supersedes every T2 and T3 figure on this page.

rumored_post_money_bn.source: Press reports including the New York Post, Aug 13 2026
rumored_post_money_bn.note: A listing expectation, not a transaction. Ruling R2: it never anchors. Worth watching because it is roughly twice the last completed mark, and the gap between the two is the market's estimate of what the IPO adds.

raised_to_date_bn.note: Includes debt. Ruling R1: capital efficiency is computed on equity only, so this figure is not the denominator.

debt_raised_bn.note: Raised to buy Alphabet-developed chips. Debt informs risk and never enters capital efficiency. At this size it is the single largest thing on the balance sheet that a valuation multiple does not see.

rumored_round.value: Reportedly seeking venture funding from Advanced Micro Devices as of 2026-07-22; no size or valuation disclosed
rumored_round.note: Ruling R2. Also note deal 340292-53T, an 11th-round Later Stage VC carrying no date, which is consistent with a round in progress.

pb_revenue_ttm_bn.source: PitchBook Revenue field, fiscal period TTM 4Q2027
pb_revenue_ttm_bn.note: House ruling R3, and unusually clear here: the period ends 2027-12-31, sixteen months after this reading. It is a forecast wearing a revenue label.

status.value: Anthropic PBC, a public benefit corporation. In IPO registration since 2026-06-01
status.note: The public-benefit structure obliges the board to weigh a public mission alongside shareholder return, which is a live governance question for a listing.

value.condition: Anthropic S-1 becomes public (expected around an October 2026 listing): the first audited numbers; supersedes every T2 and T3 figure on this page
Reported AMD funding (2026-07-22): terms disclosed and completed, or retired
IPO prices at or near the reported $2T expectation, roughly twice the $965B last mark, or prices below it

named.source: desk, on press reports of a $2T listing valuation
